e30fd0f84e3214a1: A brewing or fermentation science degree builds deep chemistry, microbiology and engineering foundations over several years. A short professional course builds working competence in a specific area, fermentation, quality control, recipe formulation, over weeks. If you are choosing between them as if they were interchangeable, you have already misunderstood what each one is for.
dca0dcd9138887fe: The better question is not which one is better, it is what you are actually trying to become. Someone aiming at a research or product development role in a large brewing company is asking a different question to someone who wants to be brewing beer on a small commercial system within six months.
